Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
On Apr 3, 7:07 pm, matt...@gmail.com wrote:
> I am sorry, to bring up.
>
> Can two minnons mask ad nauseum?
>

No. Rulebook 1.6.3. Action modifiers.

"A minion cannot play the same action modifier more than once during a
single action."

-Robert
